text: Based on the evidence, the property did not lose 67.7 ha of tree cover after the EUDR cut-off date (December 31, 2020). The tool detected no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 ha or more within the asset between 2021 and 2025. The largest loss event recorded was 67.7 ha, but this occurred in 2020, which is outside the claim interval. Minor loss of 0.4 ha was observed in 2021, but this was in patches smaller than the detectable threshold of 0.5 ha.
